summary: Read distinct key colors top-to-bottom from the right edge; for each key find its multi-cell body object and sum squared Euclidean distances over all unordered cell pairs; emit a 3-cell-block matrix with key-color headers, zero diagonal/separators, 2 for equal off-diagonal signatures, and 5 for unequal signatures.
